author: Kay ☀️ Money Loops + Identity Rewiring
transcript: Ah, wouldn't it be nice to make $30,000 per month? Hand me the money, you think. Okay, let's give it a try. Let's see if you can hold that money. I want you to sit down, close your eyes, don't drive. And then I want you to move that money into your body. You take that money from here in your mind and put it right here in your chest. Now, one of two things can happen. Either it feels good, sparkly, uncomfortable. Why does it feel uncomfortable now? Because as long as you say I want, you separate it from your reality. I want is safe. You don't have it yet. You're dreaming about it. Why this is danger? Because it's new. Because it's not familiar. Stop. Here's what to do. Number one. Realize that there is an old identity of you that does not feel comfortable with holding money. Literally, your body reacts with a feeling of not feeling safe. That's an old identity. It has nothing to do with character or that you deserve it. Second, that old identity runs a loop. And that is every time when a chunk of money comes in, the old identity is activated, doesn't feel safe and wants to get rid of it. You want the money, but the identity of you that needs to hold it in order to keep it is not used to it. So the loop is running and the loop says get rid of it. So you have to find out what kind of loop is this. For example, it could be that you don't trust yourself that you can handle money. And that loop, for example, trusting yourself, will show up in other situations in your life as well. So you have to break that loop. And once you do that, you can upgrade your identity and money will love you. And you love money. You can hold it and you can multiply it. You're thinking, what the heck, where's the fast track? And I will send you the link to the money mirror and it will show you exactly what loop is running and how you break it.
title: Why Your Body Rejects Big Money
one_liner: Your nervous system treats unfamiliar wealth like danger, triggering an identity loop that pushes money away.
key_points: The discomfort of imagining $30k/month is a nervous system safety response, not a character flaw
An old identity loop activates when money arrives and compels you to get rid of it
The specific loop (e.g. self-trust issues) shows up across multiple life areas, not just finances
Breaking the loop requires identifying it, then upgrading your identity to feel safe holding money
